latest_release.body:
# Main

- Update go build version to 1.27 (1cff2562)
- Update dependencies (eb75edcb)

# Other

- Add support xiaomi lumi.camera.gwagl01 (7793a558)
- Add support xiaomi isa.camera.isc5c1 (06cbbe55)
- Add support xiaomi chuangmi.camera.v2 on old firmwares (a37fdf38)
- Add support xiaomi chuangmi.camera.ipc019e (8f68f80b)
- Add support xiaomi isa.camera.df3 on old firmwares (6374366d)
- Add trace log for xiaomi devices list (6f75b2f7)
- Add support PCMATapo for MPEG-TS source #2159 by @ludufre (dc1685e9)
- Add camera.ui link to projects #2349 by @seydx (c245815e)
- Add support pet feeder to xiaomi source #2078 (e5bb0334)
- Move kasa source to separate module (44f6f111)
- Restore fix audio sample rate for some xiaomi cameras #2006 (01c74515)
- Improve packet loss on old TUTK proto (75bd1f1b)
- Strip Userinfo from log entries and errors #2051 (de157eb1)
- Rename mpegts module to mpeg (2735bafd)
- Fix ice_servers parsing for a list of URLs #2064 by @jmelancondev (d1d7846a)
- Fix zero channel for xiaomi source #2047 (2f9d1386)
- Fix unknown msg 0xF0 for cs2 proto (366cbd20)
- Fix error handling in stream creation and patching tests #2065 by @skrashevich (8d58cc7f)

# Docs and site

- Add meta info to website (e90f159c)
- Add sitemap to website (f68c602a)
- New documentation site #2044 by @skrashevich (7083afe9)
- Update docs (be4b6c32)
- Update documentation for clarity and accuracy #2058 by @skrashevich (6085c8aa)
- Update README #1720 by @felipecrs (6eeba1ae)
- Propose fix a couple of typos #2054 by @jeis4wpi (a41185c2)
- Fix links in docs (f3ad4ad9)
- Fix documentation grammar #2080 by @skrashevich (7f36033b)
- Fix link to updated JSONSchema #2056 by @martinbjeldbak (c7938558)
